[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (string: String) (prefixes: List String) : List String :=
  match string with
  | "" => prefixes
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_prefix := head :: List.nil
    loop tail (new_prefix :: prefixes)
loop string List.nil
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation string
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_result_length := List.length result = string.length
  simp at h_result_length
  have h_spec := by
    induction' string generalizing result
    simp [loop]
    rename_i head tail prefixes ih
    simp [loop]
    simp [List.nil]
    simp [List.cons]

    have h_prefixes_length := ih result

    simp [h_prefixes_length]
